from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.assets.acquisition_online import get_download_review

class Hou_Mcp_Download_Review(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_download_review"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("action",          "string", widget_type="text", default="review_pipeline")
        self.add_input("asset_id",        "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("provider",        "string", widget_type="text", default="megascans")
        self.add_input("local_path",      "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("checksum",        "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("pipeline_result", "any")
        self.add_output("overall_score",    "float")
        self.add_output("grade",            "string")
        self.add_output("production_ready", "bool")
        self.add_output("findings",         "list")
        self.add_output("result",           "any")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        action          = str(inputs.get("action") or "review_pipeline").strip().lower()
        asset_id        = str(inputs.get("asset_id") or "").strip()
        provider        = str(inputs.get("provider") or "megascans").strip()
        local_path      = str(inputs.get("local_path") or "").strip()
        checksum        = str(inputs.get("checksum") or "").strip()
        pipeline_result = inputs.get("pipeline_result") or {}
        try:
            review = get_download_review()
            if action == "review_download":
                r = review.review_download(asset_id, provider=provider, local_path=local_path, checksum=checksum)
            else:
                pr = pipeline_result if isinstance(pipeline_result, dict) else {}
                r = review.review_pipeline(pr)
            return {
                "overall_score":    r.overall_score,
                "grade":            r.grade,
                "production_ready": r.production_ready,
                "findings":         r.findings,
                "result":           r.to_dict(),
                "exec_out":         True,
            }
        except Exception as e:
            self.log_error(f"hou_mcp_download_review failed: {e}")
            return {"overall_score": 0.0, "grade": "F", "production_ready": False, "findings": [], "result": {}, "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Download_Review
